researched_by: user report from direct visit (Fontburn); not yet verified against published policy
policy_summary: Overnight parking is PERMITTED and CHARGED at Fontburn, £10. This is provision, not restriction - a materially different posture from the councils researched so far. Unknown whether this is a Fontburn arrangement or a Northumbrian Water tariff applying across Derwent, Kielder and other sites. That distinction decides whether water companies are a per-site job or a per-company one.
open_questions: Is the £10 signed at the car park, or published online only? Decides scrapeability.
Any conditions - self-containment, max nights, arrival/departure times, awnings?
Does the same apply at Derwent and Kielder Water?

sites.name: Fontburn Reservoir
sites.payment_notes: Machine is not always on. Hut only when staffed. Online otherwise.
sites.notes: Reported by a regular visitor, so the £10 and the payment routes are reliable. Everything else unknown. NOTE the signal dependency: if the machine is off and the hut is shut, paying needs data coverage - in a Northumberland reservoir valley that is not a safe assumption. Cross-reference against the coverage layer.
